ana: Noticed recurring spikes for tiny requests. P95 up ~200ms when mixed with bulk joins. trace below.
vik: paste trace?
ana: ```
0.000 enqueue tenant=fast size=40
0.003 enqueue tenant=bulk size=1400
0.008 coalesce -> merged -> evict fast -> fast delayed 150ms
```
ana: Proposal: add ephemeral slot-guard flag for tiny winners (guard windows = 3 epochs). guard prevents eviction by bulk unless global_fill < threshold or key_overlap high.
ovar: tradeoffs: better tail but less packing -> cost impact. Need per-tenant guard budget to avoid abuse.
vik: Implementation: per-slot uint8 flag + per-tenant uint16 credits with time decay. Evict path checks flag and credit state using atomic ops.
ana: Bench: mixed 70/30 tiny/bulk -> tiny P95 down 180ms->30ms; throughput -1.6%; est unit-cost +2.2%.
ovar: Observability: add evict_reason tag {packed, shortage, guarded} + tenant_guard_utilization metric.
ana: Rollout: feature flag -> bench -> canary -> 1% -> 10% -> rollout. Gate on tiny_p95 and unit-cost delta.
infra-bot: CI started for branch ana/slot-guard (build 5123).
